scope: No-GPU Vulkan loader-path qualification for VK_EXT_map_memory_placed: a loader-mediated harness (linked against libvulkan, never dlopening an ICD), a minimal Vulkan Profiles capability file, a documented Vulkan-Tools Mock ICD capability patch and an independent GitHub Actions workflow with a lavapipe skip lane and a mock-ICD supported lane. Loader/entry-point plumbing, capability reporting, validation cleanliness and the capability-skip logic only: no real placed-memory address semantics are exercised and no RADV/ANV/NVK/Turnip hardware result is claimed. No CI run is claimed by this receipt.
git_status_note: Only new files are created by this lane (harness, driver, mock-ICD directory, workflow, receipt); no existing repository file was modified and nothing was committed.

receipt.sha256: self-reference: this field cannot contain the hash of the file that contains it; hash the file after checkout/CI

harness.language: C11, linked against the Vulkan loader (no VK_NO_PROTOTYPES, no direct ICD dlopen)

modes.--validation: enable VK_LAYER_KHRONOS_validation + VK_EXT_debug_utils; fail on any ERROR message/VUID; fail if the layer or debug-utils is unavailable
modes.--print-all: dump every device extension reported through the loader
modes.--require-extension: turn a missing extension into FAIL instead of SKIP

supported_mode_sequence: query VK_EXT_map_memory_placed through the loader and VkPhysicalDeviceMapMemoryPlacedFeaturesEXT
vkCreateDevice with the extension plus its VK_KHR_map_memory2 dependency when advertised, and the placed feature bits enabled
create a 4 KiB TRANSFER_SRC|TRANSFER_DST buffer, allocate host-visible (device-local preferred) memory
vkMapMemory2 with VK_MEMORY_MAP_PLACED_BIT_EXT + VkMemoryMapPlacedInfoEXT at a 64 KiB-aligned address, vkUnmapMemory2, then a 4 KiB range-placed map + unmap2
vkFreeMemory/destroy buffer/device/instance and assert VK_SUCCESS on every step
harness.extension_dependency: VK_EXT_map_memory_placed depends on VK_KHR_map_memory2 or Vulkan 1.4; the harness enables VK_KHR_map_memory2 at device creation when the ICD advertises it, which the patched mock ICD does.

driver.role: runs the harness with an explicit VK_ICD_FILENAMES/VK_DRIVER_FILES, optional VK_LAYER_PATH and loader library path, parses the machine-readable output, writes a per-lane log and fails on any unmet assertion

lanes.lavapipe: RESULT=SKIP, exit 77, no VUID/ERROR when --validation is used
lanes.mock: EXTENSION_PRESENT=1, MEMORY_MAP_PLACED=1, MEMORY_MAP_RANGE_PLACED=1, DEVICE_CREATED=1, placed/range-placed map and unmap2 all VK_SUCCESS, RESULT=PASS, exit 0, and no VUID/ERROR when --validation is used

modes: --validate-profile PATH (Vulkan Profiles JSON against the official Khronos schema)
--self-test (7 canned-output assertion cases, no Vulkan driver needed)

profiles_capability_file.role: minimal Vulkan Profiles file whose MUST capabilities are VK_EXT_map_memory_placed (v1) and VkPhysicalDeviceMapMemoryPlacedFeaturesEXT {memoryMapPlaced:true, memoryMapRangePlaced:true}; intended input for a VK_LAYER_KHRONOS_profiles simulation over the mock ICD

validation.against_profiles-0.8.2-273: invalid: that older schema predates VkPhysicalDeviceMapMemoryPlacedFeaturesEXT (the extension was first present in Vulkan-Headers v1.3.278), so the -273 schema rejects the feature struct. Use profiles-0.8-latest.
validation.ci_step: the workflow runs the driver's --validate-profile against the latest Khronos schema

profiles_layer_route.why_not: Vulkan-Profiles needs a multi-package CMake bootstrap (VulkanHeaders, Vulkan-Utility-Libraries, valijson, jsoncpp) plus a Python venv created during configure; that is a sizeable, fragile CI step compared with the documented mock-ICD capability patch. The profile JSON is delivered and schema-validated so the route can be enabled later without changing the harness.
documented_route: build/install Vulkan-Profiles at a pinned tag, put its layer JSON directory on VK_LAYER_PATH

configure the layer with a vk_layer_settings.txt via VK_LAYER_SETTINGS_PATH containing 'khronos_profiles.profile_file = <path to VP_VAPOR_map_memory_placed.json>' (setting name profile_file, from layer/profiles.h in Vulkan-Profiles)
run the harness with the mock ICD and --expect supported --validation

mock_icd_patch.route: documented mock-ICD capability patch fallback (selected over the profiles-layer route)
changes: GetPhysicalDeviceFeatures2KHR: set VkPhysicalDeviceMapMemoryPlacedFeaturesEXT {memoryMapPlaced, memoryMapRangePlaced} TRUE. The stock mock advertises VK_EXT_map_memory_placed but leaves these bits false (the generated function only fills a handful of feature structs).

GetPhysicalDeviceProperties2KHR: fill the promoted VkPhysicalDeviceVulkan11Properties maxMemoryAllocationSize/maxPerSetDescriptors (the stock mock only fills the deprecated VkPhysicalDeviceMaintenance3Properties mirror; validation on a core-1.2+ instance reads the promoted struct, sees 0 and rejects any allocation).

GetPhysicalDeviceProperties2KHR: report VkPhysicalDeviceMapMemoryPlacedPropertiesEXT minPlacedMemoryMapAlignment = 4096 (stock mock leaves it 0; validation's placed-map alignment checks treat 0 as 'not aligned' and would reject the placed map).
mock_icd_patch.verification: applies cleanly to a clean pinned tree (git apply --check), mock ICD builds with the Vulkan-Tools CMake target VkICD_mock_icd, and the local supported lane plus validation lane pass with the patched ICD (see local_smoke)
mock_icd_patch.upstream_note: These are mock-ICD gaps that other users of VK_EXT_map_memory_placed + validation would hit; worth reporting to Vulkan-Tools if not already fixed.

ci_workflow.expected_cold_runtime_minutes: about 2-3 (apt + LunarG repo, pinned mock ICD build, harness compile, two short lanes); no caching used

host_vulkan_stack.why: Ubuntu 24.04 archive packages are Vulkan 1.3.275, which predate VK_EXT_map_memory_placed (first present in Vulkan-Headers v1.3.278); the matching validation layer must know the feature structs or it rejects them.

steps: install build-essential/ca-certificates/cmake/git/wget/pkg-config/python3/python3-jsonschema, add the pinned LunarG apt repo key+list, install the Vulkan host stack and mesa lavapipe
clone Vulkan-Tools at the pinned tag, verify the commit SHA, apply the mock-ICD patch, configure with -DBUILD_CUBE=OFF -DBUILD_VULKANINFO=OFF -DBUILD_TESTS=OFF, build target VkICD_mock_icd
build the loader-path harness with gcc -std=c11 -O2 -Wall -Wextra -Werror ... -lvulkan
validate the Vulkan Profiles capability file against the latest Khronos schema
Lane A: lavapipe ICD via VK_ICD_FILENAMES, --validation --expect skip --print-all (twice: assertion pass + print-all log pass)
Lane B: patched mock ICD JSON, --validation --expect supported
upload build/logs as artifact vulkan-loader-path-logs (if: always())
lane_commands: python3 tools/tests/vulkan-loader-path.py --lane lavapipe --expect skip --validation --harness build/vulkan-loader-path --icd <resolved lavapipe manifest or synthesized JSON> --log-dir build/logs --print-all
python3 tools/tests/vulkan-loader-path.py --lane mock-icd --expect supported --validation --harness build/vulkan-loader-path --icd build/vulkan-tools/icd/VkICD_mock_icd.json --log-dir build/logs
ci_workflow.failure_behaviour: the job fails if either lane's expectation is not met (exit codes, RESULT, feature bits, placed-map results or validation errors/VUIDs), if the pinned Vulkan-Tools SHA does not match, if the patch does not apply, or if the profiles schema validation/self-test fails
ci_workflow.sha256_note: Current committed workflow; supersedes the first-attempt workflow (d040ecb75a6cba35ae4d6cb799e60b0ebed2b73ef69d79a63b880e7cc498909b) after the Lane A lavapipe discovery fix.

lavapipe_discovery.problem: First CI attempt used a glob /usr/share/vulkan/icd.d/lvp_icd.*.json; Ubuntu noble-updates mesa-vulkan-drivers 25.2.8 ships /usr/share/vulkan/icd.d/lvp_icd.json (no arch suffix) with a RELATIVE library_path ("libvulkan_lvp.so"), so the glob missed it.
lavapipe_discovery.fix: Lane A now prints dpkg -L/list/find diagnostics, harvests ICD manifests and libraries from find+dpkg, accepts only genuinely-lavapipe manifests, normalises relative library_path manifests to absolute JSON copies under $BUILD_DIR, synthesizes a minimal manifest when only libvulkan_lvp*.so is present, and hard-fails only when neither exists. LAVAPIPE_ICD_SOURCE is echoed. Verified locally against 9 fake-root scenarios including the exact Mesa 25.2.8 layout.
lavapipe_discovery.de_risking: Mesa 25.2.8 source implements VK_EXT_map_memory_placed only in RADV; lavapipe has no references, so Lane A SKIP remains the correct expectation.

lunarg_apt_repo.note: CI prints the resolved package versions (dpkg-query) in the log; the repository URL is pinned so apt cannot silently pick a newer Vulkan release.

lavapipe.note: exact mesa version is whatever the pinned ubuntu-24.04 image provides and is printed by the harness (DEVICE_NAME/DEVICE_API) in the lane log

limitations: Loader/entry-point plumbing only: the mock ICD ignores the requested placement address, so placed-memory address semantics, residency, reservation and real driver behaviour are NOT tested.
lavapipe does not implement VK_EXT_map_memory_placed; Lane A only exercises the capability-skip logic and validation cleanliness on a real software ICD.
Lane B validation runs over the Vulkan-Tools Mock ICD, not over hardware; a clean VUID result there says the harness usage is valid, not that a real driver would accept it.
No RADV/ANV/NVK/Turnip (or any physical GPU) result is claimed; real placed-memory semantics still need one of those drivers on real hardware.
No Android phone/emulator was used for this lane, and no app/Steam/Wine path is involved.
The mock-ICD capability patch is a local test aid, not an upstream change: it makes the mock advertise capability bits/properties that the app would only get from a real driver.
Ubuntu 24.04 archive Vulkan packages (1.3.275) are too old for the extension, so CI depends on the pinned LunarG apt repository being reachable.
